ASSUMP-001.description: Product variable cost as percentage of Net Sales (baseline).
ASSUMP-001.rationale: Actual COGS unavailable in public dataset. 35% is a defensible mid-range for multi-category marketplace goods.

ASSUMP-002.description: Canceled / unavailable orders contribute zero Net Sales and zero Product Contribution.
ASSUMP-002.rationale: Prevents revenue recognition on non-fulfilled orders while still allowing operational cost allocation later.
